messages.subject: What does 'lineheight' do?
parts:
At first sight, the 'lineheight' parameter of element_text does nothing.

Example:

ggplot(data.frame(a=c(1,1),b=c(1,1),c=c(1,2)), aes(a, b)) +
geom_point() +
facet_wrap(~ c) +
theme(strip.text.x=element_text(lineheight=4, color='red'))

Same output regardless of the value of lineheight. Am I missing something?

Cheers.

messages.author: a3c668b849637905
messages.subject: Re: What does 'lineheight' do?
parts:
On 7 October 2013 18:45, Ernest Adrogué <nfd...@gmail.com> wrote:

ggplot(data.frame(a=c(1,1),b=c(1,1),c=c(1,2)), aes(a, b)) +
    geom_point() +
    facet_wrap(~ c) +
    theme(strip.text.x=element_text(lineheight=4, color='red'))

It's the interline space, try this,

last_plot() %+% data.frame(a=c(1,1),b=c(1,1),c=c("1\n2","2\n3"))


b.
